mapper.select: SELECT h.id AS id, h.entry_id AS entryId, h.task_id AS taskId, h.batch_id AS batchId, h.action AS action, h.action_name AS actionName, h.node_name AS nodeName, h.detail AS detail, h.operator_id AS operatorId, COALESCE(su.nick_name, su.user_name) AS operatorName, h.create_time AS createTime FROM label_entry_history h LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_id = h.operator_id WHERE h.deleted = 0 AND h.entry_id = #{entryId} ORDER BY h.create_time ASC, h.id ASC
